consent.title: Your data. Your decision.
consent.description: We can save your selected buildings, inputs and settings in your browser so you can keep your progress on this device.
consent.support: You decide. The calculation also works without optional storage.
consent.settingsDescription: Choose whether to allow local storage. You can change your choice at any time.
consent.necessaryDescription: Remembers your explicitly confirmed privacy decision for 180 days.
consent.functionalDescription: Saves your selected buildings, inputs, renovation measures and previously seen notices locally on this device. Progress is kept for 90 days after the last save or explicit resumption. Notices are remembered for 90 days.
consent.memoryOnly: Without optional storage, your progress is kept only while this page is open. Reloading or closing it will lose your inputs.
consent.storageError: Your browser could not save your choice or progress for future visits, or delete stored data. Your choice applies to this open page; you can continue calculating.
